}}'''Jimar Chubain''' is the High Captain of the guards in [[Tar Valon]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jimar Chubain}}

== Appearance ==
He looks youthful for a man in his forties. He has a pretty face and black hair.

== Activities ==
He has orders from [[Alviarin Freidhen]] to keep increasing the [[Tower Guards]] in Tar Valon.
During the [[Siege of Tar Valon]], he continues to ship men in by the rivers into Tar Valon.

He is injured during the [[Battle of Tar Valon]]. He reports to [[Saerin Asnobar]] how ineffective his men are against the [[Seanchan]] [[channeler]]s and is told to give [[Aes Sedai]] support by hanging back and having all his men use bows.{{ref/book|12|41}}

After the attack he brings forward [[Mair]], who tells Saerin about [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] being captured by the Seanchan.{{ref/book|12|41}}

He is reprimanded by [[Siuan Sanche]] for letting [[Rand al'Thor]] somehow enter the [[White Tower]] without being seen by anyone.{{ref/book|13|5}}

He is present when [[Gawyn Trakand]] carries out his investigation on the mysterious death of [[Kateri Nepvue]]. He acts very hostile towards Gawyn, until he is taken aside and is told that Gawyn wants to be Egwene's [[Warder]], not take Chubain's job.{{ref/book|13|5}}
He studies the knife thrown at Gawyn during an assassination attempt on Egwene. Neither man recognizes its make. Gawyn asks him to take some of the former [[Younglings]] under his command which he agrees to.

Chubain is one of the commanding officers on the [[Kandor]]i war-front at [[Tarmon Gai'don]].
